source: The Starter workspace checklist.md sets up: three members, three environments, three secrets, three deployed apps from seed/apps, a proxy auth token, and the members' API tokens. Modal reports neither members' MFA nor when a credential was last used or made, so the roster leaves those out, and Starter has no SSO, SCIM, restricted environments or service users.

owner.case: Signed up and owns the workspace (checklist step 1). Signs in with GitHub, as the machine account that owns the GitHub sandboxes' organizations.

manager.case: Joined through the invite link (checklist step 3). The collector signs in with this member's token. Signs in with Google, as a Gmail account made for the sandbox.

member.case: Joined through the invite link (checklist step 3). Its token checks what a Member can read, then is deleted. Signs in with Google, as a Gmail account made for the sandbox.

caller.name: sandbox-caller
caller.case: Checklist step 7. Starter can't limit a proxy auth token to environments, so it works for proxy-auth endpoints in every environment. Its secret is discarded.

owner_api_token.case: Checklist step 2. Runs the seed commands. Kept in a password manager, not in GitHub.

collector_api_token.case: Checklist step 8. The collector signs in with it.

member_api_token.case: Checklist step 9. A Member's token reads every list but the members, which needs a Manager or the Owner. Deleted after the check.

main.case: Created with the workspace. The default environment, left empty.

dev.case: Checklist step 4. Holds the public web endpoint and the api-key secret.

prod.case: Checklist step 4. Holds the proxy-auth endpoint, the scheduled job, and two secrets.

db_credentials.name: db-credentials
db_credentials.case: Checklist step 5. The scheduled job reads it every day, so it is used.

stale_token.name: stale-token
stale_token.case: Checklist step 5. No app reads it, so it is never used.

api_key.name: api-key
api_key.case: Checklist step 5. No app reads it, so it is never used.

public_api.name: sandbox-public-api
public_api.case: Checklist step 6. A web endpoint anyone with its URL can call.

private_api.name: sandbox-private-api
private_api.case: Checklist step 6. A web endpoint that needs a proxy auth token.

nightly_job.name: sandbox-nightly-job
nightly_job.case: Checklist step 6. A function on a daily schedule, with no endpoint. It reads db-credentials.
